name: Flowsery Analytics Public API
description: REST API for reading Flowsery web analytics and writing conversion events. Read traffic, revenue and engagement for any date range, break it down by page, referrer, channel, campaign, country, device, browser or OS, pull a single visitor's full activity timeline, and record goals and payments from your own backend. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`. A website API key is scoped to one website; a workspace token spans every website in the account, in which case pass `websiteId` or `domain` to pick one. All monetary values are in the website currency, as major units. All timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC. Every response carries the RFC 9331 rate-limit fields so a client can pace itself instead of discovering the limit through a 429: `RateLimit-Policy`, `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset`, the seconds until the window rolls over. A 429 adds `Retry-After` with the same number of seconds. Limits are counted per API key.
